svg.title: Private document review network connectivity
svg.desc: Approved private administration access to one PoC VNet, with application, build and private endpoint subnets. Entra identity is public and separate from private application ingress. DNS is dashed. Search shared private links are service-owned. One shared outbound-only NAT supports admin, runtime and build with separate subnet policies. Direct model inference is a runtime operation, not another workload. Shared identity retains case mutation authority. Synthetic-only.

text.tspan: Private app / data ingress. One shared outbound-only NAT; no public app or gateway IP.
Approved private route via admin VM
Identity service, not a customer PE
API checks token, owner and roles
Direct inference is an API operation
Separate subnet egress policies; deny other
Public IP does not provide inbound access
DNS supports the approved private access path
NAT is not an allowlist; Private Endpoints are not authorization
Scoped managed identities enforce data-service permissions
Solid arrows summarize access; dashed = DNS; amber = identity / outbound / build support.
Synthetic only. Shared process and identity can mutate case data; network boxes are not approval isolation.
